title: Understanding the Regression Model
text: In the given linear regression model, each parameter has a specific interpretation. The model is used to predict the blood sugar level based on whether an individual drinks soda and whether they have type $$2$$ diabetes.

title: Interpreting the Intercept
text: The intercept, represented by $$\theta_0$$, is the predicted value of the dependent variable (blood sugar) when all independent variables (drink_soda and t2d) are zero.

hintAnswer: It means the individual does not drink soda and does not have type $$2$$ diabetes.
title: Identifying the Conditions
text: What does it mean for $$drink_{soda}$$ and t2d to be zero in this context?

hintAnswer: $$\theta_0$$ is the predicted blood sugar for someone who does not drink soda and does not have type $$2$$ diabetes.
